FAQ's

Got Questions? We've Got Answers.

How much does a private office cost in Calgary?

Private offices at WurkHub start from $850/month, fully furnished and move-in ready. This includes 24/7 access, high-speed WiFi, meeting room hours, and a professional business address at 602 12 Ave SW in downtown Calgary.

Can I use WurkHub as my business address?

Absolutely. All members can use our premium 602 12 Avenue SW, Calgary address for business registration, mail, and client correspondence.

Do you offer meeting room rentals?

Yes. Boardroom and meeting room access is included with most packages. Non-members can also book meeting rooms by the hour.

What are your operating hours?

Our reception is staffed Monday–Friday, [time] – [time]. However, all office and desk members enjoy 24/7 keycard access to the building.

Is there a long-term lease required?

No. We offer flexible month-to-month agreements with no long-term commitments. Scale up, scale down, or move on — it's your call.

What's included in the virtual office package?

Our virtual office includes a professional Calgary business address, mail and package handling, phone/fax forwarding, and optional virtual secretary support.

Where is WurkHub located?

We're at 602 12 Avenue SW, Calgary, Alberta T2R 1J3 — right in the heart of downtown Calgary's Beltline district, easily accessible by transit and walking distance from major hubs.

Can I tour the space before signing up?

Of course! We encourage it. Book a free tour online or call us at ([phone]. We'll show you around and help find the right fit for your needs.
